name: cascade-groundtruth-intermediate-mismatch
trigger: stage 2 is trained/validated on true intermediate variables but production inference receives stage-1 predictions
risk: stage-2 validation is optimistic because training-serving distributions differ and stage-1 errors are absent
gate: create out-of-fold stage-1 predictions for all stage-2 training rows
fit stage 2 on predicted rather than oracle intermediates
report per-stage plus cascade metrics and uncertainty propagation
